svg.title: Canada Life IDP Azure reference architecture (Canada, single region)
svg.desc: A general-purpose, single-Canada-region blueprint: App Service web/api, Function App worker, Cosmos DB for MongoDB, Key Vault, Azure AI Foundry with Content Understanding and an optional judge agent, Container Registry, Log Analytics/Application Insights, optional Managed Grafana and an optional demo email relay, with least-privilege RBAC edges between them.
svg.text: Canada Life IDP — Azure Reference Architecture (Canada)
General-purpose, single-region blueprint for the AI document-processing platform — least-privilege RBAC throughout
A tag-based policy exemption permits the public endpoints used in this blueprint (see "Governance exemption" below)
All platform resources co-located in one Canadian region for data residency
Microsoft Entra ID — system-assigned managed identities

text.tspan: web / api / worker / Grafana / Foundry project — zero API keys
also used as the Function App content store
Regional VNet integration for the API/worker, only when a
private authenticated SMTP relay is configured (needs an EP plan)
Secrets store: DB connection strings, signing
secret, API tokens, SMTP password (if configured)
disableLocalAuth: true — Entra/RBAC only, no API keys
Primary deployment: Content Understanding analyzer model
Optional isolated judge model deployment + Agent Service
custom prompt agent for automated quality review
pulled by managed identity — no admin user/credentials
domain SMTP AUTH for demo/testing only
diagnostic settings from every compute resource
Tag-based policy exemption — documents an approved

svg.text: api → kv: Key Vault Secrets User
worker → kv: Key Vault Secrets User
worker → foundry: Cognitive Services User + Foundry User
foundry → appi: project MI: Log Analytics Reader + Privil…
Official Microsoft Azure Architecture Center icons. Dashed boxes/edges denote optional or conditional components (e.g. an optional judge agent, demo email relay, private networking, Grafana).
